description: "The Comic Adventures of Old Mother Hubbard, and Her Dog" by Sarah Catherine Martin is a charming children’s book written in the early 19th century. This playful work presents a series of whimsical tales revolving around the character of Old Mother Hubbard and her extraordinary dog.
